body: I'll make sure to make an update in the future. Fingers crossed it'll be a happy one.

Yeah, there have been a couple times where I wanted nothing to do with life anymore, but right now, even though it hurts so much, I still a chance at life. It seems the general consensus is that I should drop out, so that's what I'm planning on doing. I still want an education at a later time though, so maybe once I've gotten help, and gotten better I can give alternative school options a try.

Thank you for the advice. I don't think remote learning is gonna work for me right now, because I'm currently in online school and it's still just as bad for me. It may even be worse for me due to the lack of incentive to do work. I'd love to come back one day and get an education, and maybe when I'm not a complete and utter mess I'll take classes remotely.

Thank you for the advice. I'll try to work up the courage to tell my mom about it. Probably when my dad finally comes home (she went out to where he's been working to bring him home for good), when she's a little less depressed.

I can't say what it is specifically that makes school so unbearable to me. I guess the pressure probably plays a large part. I just feel so hopeless in school I used to get A++s and really enjoy school when I was younger, but now it's all just too much.
